_comment: Architectural Purpose: Plugin-scoped Model Context Protocol (MCP) & A2A service manifest.
Discovered automatically by MCP-capable agent hosts (Antigravity / Jetski and Claude Code)
when the google-ads-api-developer-assistant plugin is loaded.
Configures and launches the local Agent-to-Agent (A2A) HTTP sidecar
with plugin-isolated Google Ads credentials (config/google-ads.yaml), exposing /health and
/v1/a2a/tasks endpoints for GAQL validation, Protobuf inspection, Ruff-linted code generation,
conversion diagnostics, and HITL-verified Google Ads API mutations.
